entries.review: Read full 46-line path walker and both production consumers. The cycle key is now the complete normalized pending path rather than a traversed directory component. A repeated alias with a different suffix represents progress and remains allowed; a repeated complete state is a cycle. Each restart still adds one unique state and the 65th unique state still fails, preserving the 64-resolution bound. OS comparer, modern ResolveLinkTarget and legacy Target branches, absolute/relative target handling, file lookup failures, caller containment and stricter consumer reparse policy remain unchanged. This is component-wise resolution under the existing no-hostile-concurrent-filesystem assumption; no atomic filesystem snapshot guarantee.

Read changed test hunk with enclosing POSIX symlink gate, fixture cleanup and fallback Get-Item capability wrapper. Fixture creates an actual directory alias and a leaf symlink whose absolute target re-enters that alias with a different suffix; this reproduces the macOS /var traversal on Linux. Positive control checks exact final path in modern and capability-suppressed legacy branches. Real 64-link and 65-link chains and a two-link cycle exercise allowed bound and typed rejection. Canonicalizing fixture root prevents incidental macOS /var links from altering the intentional 64-link count. Existing outside-link denial, hardlink acceptance, root-relative-link fallback and consumer stricter reparse rejection remain. Fixture paths are GUID-scoped and all links are removed by existing finally cleanup. Native Windows link privilege coverage is not claimed.
